title: Build strict beta evidence verifier and current normal app
description: Follow team/PLAN.md, team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules and applicable child plan; preserve current dirty work. This board records unfinished acceptance/repair, not permission to rebuild existing features. Inspect current implementation and earlier evidence first; fix only reproduced gaps in owned files, record exact commands/results and fail-first controls, and report CLAIMED. No installs, new packages, commits, pushes, publication, real-library access or destructive cleanup. Before expensive checks, acquire exclusive registered path node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot via team.py files add; if another live task owns it, do independent work or hand off rather than overlap runs. Retain full logs and use pinned Node/offline serial Rust/production-preview Playwright. Independent review is required. Create scripts/verify-beta-evidence.py and D2 EVIDENCE.json plus exact source/artifact manifest. No signing/notary/download fields: descoped. Use passed/failed/blocked/not-run honestly; owner outcomes remain pending and may keep beta-readiness command nonzero, without blocking concrete owner-testing preparation. Reject doctored missing-native, blocked Word claimed passed, source mismatch, smoke binary and missing asset cases individually. Run final sequential tsc/build/full units/full production-preview Playwright/offline Rust/isolated baseline+beta and applicable native print matrix, retaining full logs. Rebuild normal npm run tauri build after all diagnostics; inspect actual app identity/version/freshness/no-smoke markers and hash manifest. No installs, stale bundle substitution or release-readiness claim on blocked checks. Write the task report to docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-team-reconciliation/evidence.md.
